title: Свадьба Нагиева и пропавшая севрюга  (Nagiyev's Wedding and the Missing Sturgeon)

scenes.title: Развод в ЗАГСе и спор родителей  (Divorce at the Registry and the Parents' Fight)
scenes.summary: At the registry office, Vika confirms she wants a divorce and refuses to tell Max who the baby's father is, while Barinov and Eleonora argue over Katya.

scenes.title: Клептомания Сени  (Senya's Kleptomania)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov lists all the groceries Senya tried to steal this week and warns him that one more theft means immediate dismissal.

scenes.title: Жених Дмитрий Нагиев  (Groom Dmitry Nagiyev)
scenes.summary: Eleonora introduces Vika to the celebrity groom holding his wedding at the restaurant—Dmitry Nagiyev—while Max drinks with Kostya before his train.

scenes.title: Подозрение падает на Нагиева  (Suspicion Falls on Nagiyev)
scenes.summary: Seeing Vika with Nagiyev and hearing that Nagiyev's wedding is in a month, Max convinces himself that Nagiyev is the father of Vika's baby.

scenes.title: Дорогая севрюга  (The Expensive Stellate Sturgeon)
scenes.summary: Lyova inspects a fresh delivery of expensive stellate sturgeon from Timur, and Senya begs Lyova to cut him a small piece to try.

scenes.title: Ужин из воды и аспирина  (A Dinner of Water and Aspirin)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov brings hungover Katya water and aspirin and offers to take her out somewhere fun to take her mind off Denis.

scenes.title: Подпольное казино  (The Underground Casino)
scenes.summary: Barinov takes Katya to an underground poker club where they run into Mikhail, while Max says goodbye to Vika before spotting her with Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Драка в казино и психолог  (Casino Brawl and the Psychologist)
scenes.summary: After Barinov gets into a fistfight defending Katya at the casino, Eleonora brings a psychologist to treat Katya's depression.

scenes.title: Пропажа севрюги  (The Disappearance of the Sturgeon)
scenes.summary: When an order for sturgeon comes in, Lyova discovers the fish is missing and blames Senya, who vows to find the real culprit.

scenes.title: Побег через балкон  (Escape Across the Balcony)
scenes.summary: Katya gets her psychologist drunk and climbs out the balcony, where she finds Max getting roughed up by Nagiyev's security guards.

scenes.title: Допрос Феди и предложение Кати  (Interrogating Fedya and Katya's Proposal)
scenes.summary: Senya interrogates Fedya and Louis about the walk-in cooler, while a tipsy Katya proposes that Max marry her to get back at Vika.

scenes.title: Несостоявшаяся помолвка  (The Short-Lived Engagement)
scenes.summary: Max asks Chef Barinov for Katya's hand in marriage because he thinks Vika is marrying Nagiyev, until Barinov reveals Nagiyev has another bride.

scenes.title: Реконструкция преступления  (Reconstructing the Crime)
scenes.summary: Katya drinks alone and talks to an imaginary Denis, while Senya gathers the kitchen staff to explain how the sturgeon fell from the shelf.

scenes.title: Оправдание Арсения Чуганина  (The Vindication of Arseny Chuganin)
scenes.summary: Senya leads the team to the courtyard dumpsters, where Ainura opens the discarded box and finds the spoiled stellate sturgeon inside.

scenes.title: Знакомство с невестой Нагиева  (Meeting Nagiyev's Bride)
scenes.summary: While Vika shows Nagiyev and his bride Natasha the dining room for their wedding, Max interrupts and tells Natasha that Vika is carrying Nagiyev's baby.

scenes.title: Наташа бросает Нагиева  (Natasha Dumps Nagiyev)
scenes.summary: Natasha storms out of the hotel leaving Nagiyev, and Vika confesses to a stunned Nagiyev that she told Max the baby was his.

scenes.title: Нагиев в баре и паника у двери Кати  (Nagiyev at the Bar and Panic at Katya's Door)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev confirms to Max that he is not the baby's father and invites him to drink, while Barinov breaks down Katya's door and thinks she swallowed pills.

scenes.title: Сеня продаёт тухлую рыбу  (Senya Sells the Spoiled Fish)
scenes.summary: Senya shows off a whole fresh sturgeon he received as a reward, then sells the spoiled sturgeon from the trash to supplier Timur.

scenes.title: Конфетки для свежего дыхания  (Candies for Fresh Breath)
scenes.summary: At the hospital, Katya tells Barinov and Eleonora that the 'pills' were just breath mints and that she will never forgive them for the stomach pump.

scenes.title: Правда о разводе родителей  (The Truth About Her Parents' Divorce)
scenes.summary: Barinov reveals he left Eleonora because she cheated on him with a waiter, which helps Katya let go of Denis, while Vika hides the truth from Max.
